description: This file defines a NoteEditor component for a note management UI, providing editing, deletion, and display functionalities for a note object within a LightningJS application.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing and deleting notes, with internal state management and rendering logic.

methods.name: _emitChange
methods.description: Emits the change to the parent component via the onChange callback with updated note data.

methods.name: _appendChar
methods.description: Appends a character to the current title or body of the note, depending on the editing mode.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the current title or body of the note.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion confirmation; if confirmed within timeout, calls onDelete callback.
